title: Watch snow sculptors at work in Breckenridge
description: In Breckenridge, international teams begin with towering blocks of snow and carve them by hand into forms that seem too delicate to stand. Visit while the artists are working to see the scale of the effort, or wander among the finished pieces after illumination. The mountain town becomes an outdoor gallery for art that lasts only as long as winter allows.
teaser: See giant snow blocks become detailed works of art.
goodToKnow: Check the current sculpture schedule and prepare for altitude, cold and possibly icy footing.
whyItMightDelightYou: Watching the artists remove snow, rather than add material, changes the way you see the finished sculptures.
